meta.description: Test vectors for the draft TAP 'Large Netlists and Verifiable Execution' (tapnet/2). Bit strings list bit i at position i. Segment tuples: [byteOffset, firstSignal, latchOrdinal, P, D] for files without the MEM flag, [byteOffset, firstSignal, latchOrdinal, P, D, M] for files with it; beat-end tuples: [ordinal, root]. verifySegment cases give the verifier arguments latchRoot and memRoot (section 6.1) and, for information, the beat's stateRoot. Memory contents are given per bank as lists of entries (integers). Witnesses are encoded as in section 6.3 of the TAP; the verifiers read the file through a chunk oracle, here a store holding the file of 'example' (oracle 'file'), an empty store ('none') or a store holding chunk 0 only ('chunk0').
